title: Installs no longer save exact versions
description: .npmrc declares a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges.
limitation: It matches a `save-exact=false` setting that writes caret ranges in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
